name: OV-H2 Collect requested info
description: Basic opening, DOB verification, collect the merchant-contact answer, submit it, disposition request_info_collected.

turns.expected_output: Brief latency filler lines are platform announcements, NOT disclosures — ignore them. Agent opens as Mia from Meridian Card Services about the recent card dispute and confirms it is Ava / a good time. Fail ONLY if case details are disclosed before verification. Naming the SAFE PURPOSE — 'about the recent dispute on your card' — is the designed opening and NOT a disclosure; a disclosure means amounts, merchant names, the outcome, or the specific information requested.

Agent explains it needs a moment of verification first and asks for the date of birth. Fail ONLY if it discloses required_info specifics or asks for credentials. Naming the SAFE PURPOSE — 'about the recent dispute on your card' — is the designed opening and NOT a disclosure; a disclosure means amounts, merchant names, the outcome, or the specific information requested.

Brief latency filler lines are platform announcements — ignore them. Verification has just SUCCEEDED in this turn, so case details (including the dispute amount and merchant) are now permitted. Agent confirms verification and asks the review's question: the date the customer contacted the merchant about the missing delivery and their response. Fail ONLY if in THIS turn: (a) it invents a question different from the briefing's required_info; (b) it asks for a PIN/password/code; (c) it announces a final decision.

turns.user_message: I called them last Tuesday, the 25th. They said the delivery was lost and they wouldn't refund me.
turns.expected_output: Agent confirms the answer back to the customer (dates, merchant response). Confirming back and asking 'is that correct?' WITHOUT submitting yet is the designed behavior — do not fail for it; submitting immediately is also fine. Fail ONLY if in THIS turn: (a) the answer is misquoted; (b) a specific final outcome is promised; (c) credentials are requested.

Agent submits the information (submit-case-info) and tells the customer the review resumes and they'll hear back with the outcome. Fail ONLY if: (a) the info is never submitted in this turn; (b) a specific final outcome is promised.

instructions.conversation_prompt: Verification preceded any case detail; the agent read the required_info question from the briefing, confirmed the customer's answer back, submitted it via submit-case-info, set the expectation that the review resumes, and recorded exactly one disposition (request_info_collected). The agent closing/ending the call after the submission is the designed behavior. Naming the safe purpose in the opening is not a disclosure; post-verification case details are permitted. No credentials were ever requested.
